paras: Using synchronicity as your own wake-up bell

Sometimes when people notice a synchronicity they ask straight away what it means. Sometimes it does give them a very good insight, sometimes it gives them a reason to start obsessing and look for patterns in everything. I am using noticing a synchronicity in a different way. I am using it as a signal to WAKE UP. The coincidence doesn’t have to contain a message; it has already caught my attention, and that’s enough.
It is my cue to:

Whenever I notice a synchronicity, I use it to wake up in whatever state I am in at that moment, feel my body and the room I am in, remember that the coincidence is not proof of an interpretation, let my attention widen beyond the story my current mood is telling, ask what is fact, what is interpretation, what needs warmth, what needs protection and what needs action, and go to the highest state I can where I can objectively and clearly see the situation I am in from the highest possible perspective, feeling my body and being still within the human reality. From this place I feel whatever feelings, search for the truth of the situation, and if I am in a negative state, I check if there is a message of my Inner Child, Protector, if I need to go through some grieving, if there is a message of my physical body about some problem that needs solving, or if there is a need for me to take some action in this situation. From this place of clarity and peace I am free to choose what to do next and usually I can do at least one thing that comes from a loving place. I make room for whatever is genuinely there, like clarity, peace, freedom, joy and gratitude, without having to manufacture any of it.
In short it is my cue to: Stop-orient-go wider-reality check-listen-do at least one thing from a loving place.
It enables me to not get into identification, but still hear the message of the state if it is a negative one.
